title: Energy Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly express the energy of the rotational state E_J in terms of J, M, and D.

title: Selection Rule Derivation
description: Important Criteria: The student must derive the selection rule for electric dipole radiation, showing the conditions for changes in J and m.

title: Frequency Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must derive the frequency of emitted radiation as a function of J, M, and D.

title: Correct Units
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all derived expressions have the correct physical units.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as sign mistakes in the selection rule or incorrect factors in the energy expression.

title: Moment of Inertia
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly identify and use the moment of inertia I = 1/2 M D^2 in their calculations.
